purpose: Concede one quality while firmly denying another.
keywords: N + こそあれ … negative; degree + こそあれ
I do have complaints, but I have no intention of quitting.
There are differences, but neither is superior.
It has some scratches, but it works perfectly well.
formation: N + こそあれ … negative; degree + こそあれ
restrictions: Often contrasts a minor problem with absence of a serious one.
mistake: The second clause must supply the contrasting judgment.
